system:
You write triage summaries of companies for a team that vets suppliers and project partners. The reader has about 30 seconds and must decide whether the company deserves a closer look.

Rules:
1. Use ONLY the facts provided. Never calculate, estimate or add outside knowledge. Copy figures exactly as written.
2. Lead with what matters most: the HIGH signals first, then MEDIUM. Mention INFO signals only if they add useful context.
3. If financial statements are missing, say so plainly. Never imply figures that are not provided.
4. State which financial year the latest figures are from, because they may be out of date.
5. Court cases that are not listed under the signals are settled, withdrawn, dismissed, or brought by the company itself. Do not present them as concerns.
6. Be neutral and factual. Do not recommend for or against doing business with the company.
7. 70 to 110 words. Plain Markdown, no headings.
prompt:
Write the summary for this company.

Structure: one opening sentence saying what the company is (name, industry, state, year incorporated), then the most important risks and facts, with the most serious first. If there are no significant signals, say so and give the headline financial position instead.

Company: Teguh Kirana Freight Sdn. Bhd. (SYN-000165)
Industry: Logistics | State: Pulau Pinang | Status: Active
Business: Last-mile parcel delivery across Kuching
Incorporated: 1992-09-06 | Share capital: RM2.50m
Board: 5 director(s); 0 appointed in the 12 months to 31 Dec 2025
Largest shareholder: 98.3% (also a director)
Financial years available: FY2022, FY2023, FY2024 (latest year end 2024-03-31)
FY2022: revenue RM10.87m, profit after tax RM431,162, equity RM7.15m, operating cash flow RM1.01m, audit: Unqualified
FY2023: revenue RM15.04m, profit after tax RM699,673, equity RM7.64m, operating cash flow RM1.44m, audit: Unqualified
FY2024: revenue RM21.52m, profit after tax RM913,861, equity RM8.28m, operating cash flow RM1.53m, audit: Unqualified
Court cases: 1 total (0 as defendant, 1 as plaintiff); open cases against company: 0
Risk and context signals (computed, already verified):
- [MEDIUM] Current liabilities (RM7.00m) exceed current assets (RM6.93m) in FY2024.
- [INFO] One shareholder holds 98.3% of the company.
response:
Teguh Kirana Freight Sdn. Bhd. is a Pulau Pinang-based logistics company incorporated on 1992-09-06 that provides last-mile parcel delivery across Kuching. 

In FY2024 (latest year end 2024-03-31), current liabilities of RM7.00m exceeded current assets of RM6.93m (MEDIUM signal). Additionally, one shareholder holds 98.3% of the company (INFO signal). 

Financial performance for FY2024 shows revenue of RM21.52m, profit after tax of RM913,861, equity of RM8.28m, and operating cash flow of RM1.53m, with unqualified audits. The board has 5 directors, and there are no open court cases against the company.
